        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Test Recursion
        run: cargo test --package recursion

  extension-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Test Extensions
        run: cargo test --package extension-tests

  riscv:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Test RISC-V
        run: cargo test --package riscv

  guest-lib-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Test Guest Library
        run: cargo test --package guest-lib-tests

  benchmarks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Run Benchmarks
        run: cargo bench

  benchmarks-execute:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Execute Benchmarks
        run: ./scripts/benchmarks.sh

  docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Generate Docs
        run: cargo doc --document-private-items

  native-compiler:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Compile Native Code
        run: ./scripts/native-compile.sh

merge-group:
  on:
    pull_request_target:
      types: [labeled]

    merge-checks:
      runs-on: ubuntu-latest
      steps:
        - name: Check merge group
